title: You Can Go Ghost Hunting in Albany's Oldest Home - Here's How
excerpt: Ever wanted to look for ghosts? Explore what goes bump in the night? Albany' oldest home at 48 Hudson Avenue is holding an event that will teach you the history of the building and explore the spooky side of it.
content:
The nights are getting darker, the air crisp, and the veil is starting to thin. It is spooky season and it is this time of year that we get to explore all those things that go bump in the night. If you're into history or are a paranormal enthusiast you have an opportunity to scratch both of those itches with a ghost hunt in Albany.

Historic Albany is giving folks an opportunity to explore the oldest house in Albany, at 48 Hudson Ave. This is the site of the Van Ostrande-Radliff House. 

Read More: What Makes Sleepy Hollow A Halloween Favorite In New York?

What is 48 Hudson Ave in Albany?

This home was built in 1728 and is one of the few remaining Dutch homes still left standing in America. It is also officially documented as the oldest house in Albany, NY. Given that this home has been around for hundreds of years you can bet that it has seen a few things over those centuries. Now, you get to find out.

Get Tickets: Click Here

Join me, BJ, as I co-host a ghost hunt at this home. It's a place that I've investigated before while doing ghost hunting and found some very interesting things while there. I'll go over some of my stories, and my friend Cara Macri will go through the history of the home as well as some other haunting accounts that have happened there.

Event Details

If you've ever been curious about Albany's history, or the spooky side of it, this is the event for you. It will happen from 6p-8p on October 23, 2026.
